activity_summary: On the facing leaf you wrote what is owed of the Queen, what has been made and left unended, and a list in no column. Under Words you wrote that Nick's voice went at Richmond on the twenty-eighth, and that the next wants a different music. The workmen are to be men before they are asses. You did not write a reason beside any of the money.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the facing leaf and set the pen down.

facets.activity: Wrote the facing leaf and stopped
